overview: This one-page file index lists State Department papers concerning Japanese news-gathering and press activity in Argentina, especially the establishment, financing, and operation of the Domei News Agency’s Buenos Aires office. Its entries also cover Japanese-language newspapers in Buenos Aires, a commemorative telephone conversation between Buenos Aires and Tokyo, subscription increases, Japanese press coverage of international news during May and June 1943, and Justice Department information about Domei personnel and related news-agency activity. Several entries direct researchers to related decimal-file materials under 894.20235 and 835.911.

subfiles.title: List of papers on Japanese news-gathering agencies in Argentina
subfiles.about: An index summarizes papers concerning the Domei News Agency and Japanese-language press activity in Argentina.
subfiles.summary: The sheet records papers about Masao Tsuda’s arrival to establish a Domei office in Buenos Aires and later financial support for his work. Other entries concern Japanese newspapers in Argentina, a Buenos Aires–Tokyo telephone conversation commemorating nearly one year of the Greater East Asia War, subscription increases, and a report on international-news coverage during May and June 1943. Justice Department entries provide or acknowledge information about Tsuda and other news-agency matters, while cross-references point to related files 894.20235 and 835.911.

interest: The index offers a compact map of U.S. official monitoring of Japan’s overseas information network in wartime Argentina. It is especially useful for tracing the intersection of news collection, propaganda, financial support, immigrant-language newspapers, and long-distance communications between Buenos Aires and Tokyo. Its cross-references identify related files that may contain the underlying reports, while the varying spellings of newspaper titles and the OCR-obscured Justice Department entries warn researchers to consult the originals when identifying publications and individuals.
